slices.title: LibreOffice-under-bwrap spike and fidelity corpus
slices.summary: Spike whether LibreOffice converts Office files under the execution-core bwrap argv within budget (cold start <= 25 s, RSS <= 1 GiB), using a throwaway read-only /skills bind, and add the 4 good and 6 broken Office fidelity corpus files (each <= 30 KB). The result decides D5: LibreOffice in the image versus a sidecar.
test_commands: cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -q -p execution-core sandbox

slices.title: FE artifact renderer registry
slices.summary: Add a pure artifact renderer registry (ArtifactRenderer with id, match and priority; built-ins for image, html, document, code, pdf, binary and text), turn artifactRenderKind into a thin wrapper over it, and add a Dynamic slot in ChatArtifactPanel for registered extra kinds. No behaviour change for existing kinds.
test_commands: cd "apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3" && pnpm vitest run src/features/chat/components/chat-artifacts.test.ts src/features/chat/components/ChatArtifactPanel.test.tsx src/features/chat/components/artifact-renderers.test.ts && pnpm typecheck

slices.title: Structural Office verifier, report contract and model-facing report
slices.summary: Add a hermetic structural checker for docx, xlsx, pptx and pdf that runs sandboxed on a second per-file workspace with no network and returns a typed OfficeVerification report (passed, warnings, failed, skipped). The report rides the existing ExecuteStepResponse.output and its text is copied into the model's summary and repair sentence; the check is advisory and sits behind an off, structural or render switch.
slices.flag: CODE_INTERPRETER_OFFICE_VERIFY=off|structural|render (default off in code; structural in the dev compose only after proof); OFFICE_VERIFY_MAX_FILES; OFFICE_VERIFY_TIMEOUT_SECS (default 60); OFFICE_VERIFY_MAX_CONCURRENCY (default 2); an unknown value means off with a warning
test_commands: cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -q -p execution-core --all-targets && cargo test -q -p mp-contracts && cargo test -q -p model-gateway --all-targets

slices.title: Verification reaches the user (chip and enforce)
slices.summary: Carry the report on the attachment SSE event as an optional check key (no new event name) and show a generated-file chip (Kontrollert, Advarsler, Feil funnet, via i18n.tr) that never claims the file was verified in Office. In enforce mode a failed file is withheld once per turn per name so the model can repair it.
slices.flag: CODE_INTERPRETER_VERIFY_ENFORCE (gateway, opt-in, default off; enable only after the corpus shows under 2 percent false failed)
test_commands: cd "apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3" && pnpm vitest run src/features/chat/components/chat-artifacts.test.ts src/features/chat/components/ChatArtifactPanel.test.tsx src/features/chat/components/artifact-renderers.test.ts && pnpm typecheck

slices.title: LibreOffice and fonts image layer: render, recalc, thumbnails
slices.summary: Add a separate LibreOffice, poppler and fonts RUN to the execution-core image, and a render path in check.py (conversion, page count, recalculated copy for formula errors, font substitution, thumbnails) that returns capped previews. A missing soffice is a warning, never a failure; the shipped file is never replaced by the recalculated copy; the probe stays out of sandbox capability health.
slices.flag: CODE_INTERPRETER_OFFICE_VERIFY=render (rollback to structural; the layer is inert when off); OFFICE_PREVIEW_MAX_BYTES (2 MiB PDF preview cap); thumbnails at most 3 and 150 KB each

slices.title: Office previewer in the artifact panel
slices.summary: Attach an optional transient PDF preview (page count, substitution flag, thumbnails) to the attachment event and render it in a new office-pdf renderer as a sandboxed PDF frame with a page strip and a font-substitution notice, falling back to the file card. The download still returns the byte-identical sandbox output.

slices.title: Skill bundle store and API in capability-core
slices.summary: Add an org-scoped skill bundle store in capability-core (manifest, per-file rows, digest-addressed blobs in Postgres, never global) with admin-only, flag-gated PUT, GET and DELETE routes, three read RPCs (ListSkillBundles, GetSkillBundleManifest, GetSkillBlob) and audit events. Caps are 256 files, 8 MiB total and 1 MiB per file, with SKILL.md required; bundles do not touch agent_skills.
slices.flag: SKILL_BUNDLES_ENABLED (capability-core, default off; upload returns 404 when off; tables remain on rollback)
test_commands: cd "apps/Model Plane/go/services/capability-core" && go test ./... && go vet ./...

slices.title: skill_file tool and three-stage disclosure
slices.summary: Add a read-only skill_file tool, offered only when a matched skill has a bundle, that returns one path from this org's bundle with a 32 KiB read cap and paging marker, and refuses traversal and binary content. The skill block gets a bundle footer inside the existing 8,000-character budget, with bundles fetched via ListSkillBundles.
slices.flag: SKILL_FILE_TOOL_ENABLED (gateway, default off); offered only when a matched skill has a bundle

slices.title: Read-only /skills mount in the sandbox
slices.summary: Add SkillMount as ExecuteStepRequest field 14 (Appendix B N4 supersedes the table's 13) and derive mounts server-side from skills matched this turn (at most 3; the model cannot name a bundle). execution-core digest-verifies each bundle and materialises a read-only /skills tree through LaunchOptions.extra_ro_binds, so scripts can read but not write it, with no network.
slices.flag: SKILL_BUNDLE_MOUNT_ENABLED (gateway, default off); execution-core honours skill_mounts only when the field is present

slices.title: Four first-party Office bundles
slices.summary: Write SKILL.md bundles for docx, xlsx, pptx and pdf under apps/Model Plane/skills/office, copy them into the execution-core image at /opt/verevon/skills/office, and register them per org as builtin skills with trigger keywords that survive learned refreshes. A contract test checks that the embedded text matches the copied file.
